name: T02

theorem T02 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2

author: private-a1
name: T04
source:
theorem T04 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  rw [T02] at h6
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hS
  have hS' : m.S ≤ 0 := by omega
  have a : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)) (Int.sq_nonneg N)
  have b : 0 ≤ (-m.S) * N * M :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) h5) (by omega)
  have e : M ^ 2 = M * M := by grind
  have hM2 : 0 < M ^ 2 := by
    rw [e]; exact Int.mul_pos h4 h4
  have c : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos h1 hM2
  have b' : (-m.S) * N * M = -(m.S * N * M) := by grind
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S

author: private-a1
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s hdet hp hDD hS n hn
  rw [T02]
  unfold Scope.modeN Scope.modeM
  have h1 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have hk0 : (1:Int)*1 ≤ (n:Int)*(n:Int) := Int.mul_le_mul h1 h1 (by omega) (by omega)
  have hk : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int)^2 := by grind
  have hs : 0 ≤ s^2 := Int.sq_nonneg s
  have hkn : 0 ≤ (n:Int)^2 * s^2 := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) hs
  have h2 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS hkn
  have hA : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s^2 * ((n:Int)^2 * s^2) * ((n:Int)^2 - 1) :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg hDD hs) hkn) (by omega)
  have hp2 : 0 < p^2 := by
    have := Int.mul_pos hp hp
    grind
  have hq : 0 < (p^2)^2 := by
    have := Int.mul_pos hp2 hp2
    grind
  have hD : 0 < m.detJ * (p^2)^2 := Int.mul_pos hdet hq
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

author: private-a1
name: T10
source:
theorem T10 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N := by
  intro m N M hM hN hP h
  rw [T02] at h
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hc
  have h1 : m.S * N ≤ m.detJ * M := Int.not_lt.mp hc
  have h2 : m.S * N * M ≤ m.detJ * M * M := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Int.le_of_lt hM)
  have h4 : 0 ≤ N * N := Int.mul_nonneg hN hN
  have h3 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * (N * N) := Int.mul_nonneg hP h4
  have e1 : N ^ 2 = N * N := by grind
  have e2 : M ^ 2 = M * M := by grind
  rw [e1, e2] at h
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N
